correctness.rationale: The independently constructed 24-vertex cubic graph has exactly 37,076 augmented faces and 219,240 Hasse covers. A complete matching has 18,536 pairs and four unmatched 5-faces; exhaustive topological sort of the reversed matched Hasse graph visits all 37,076 faces. Deleting the paired empty face produces a CW model with one vertex and four 5-cells. Two distinct signed Lefschetz trace computations agree for all 48 full graph automorphisms; the character formula matches every action, and irreducibility follows from the signed-coordinate representation. No infinite extrapolation or unverified log is used.

value.rationale: This is the canonical 24-vertex three-dimensional permutahedral graph with its full 48-element octahedral automorphism group. Previously known four-sphere homotopy gives only a rank. The complete action splits into two inequivalent 1- and 3-dimensional irreducibles, detects the nontrivial central inversion -I4, and excludes globally invariant rational homology. The ten-class table is a precise symmetry-sensitive invariant with applications to equivariant topology of the permutahedron; it is not a generic homotopy-rank deduction.
